pr_title: Handle hidden scratchpad containers in commands
pr_body:
Fixes #3236

This fixes the handling of hidden scratchpad containers for some
commands. For the most part, this just prevents running the commands on
hidden scratchpad containers, but there are some commands that have some
special handling for them.

issue_context.title: Some commands crash sway when operating on hidden scratchpad containers
issue_context.body:
Sorry for not digging into it further and not isolating the specific commands which cause the crash. However, the config is only minimally changed from the default config (last 4 lines are relevant).
Also, please tell me how I could improve the issue title.

Sway version: `sway version 1.0-beta.1-256-ga22d0c0f (Nov 28 2018, branch 'master')`

Sway config: https://gist.github.com/camoz/dd915707940dd72d386e1ea8b1546e11
Relevant are the four lines.




# Steps to reproduce
* start sway with attached config file (see last 4 lines)
* press $mod+Shift+backslash (which will run the command `termite --name="scratchterm_full"`)
# What happens
Sway crashes, see debug log: https://gist.github.com/camoz/99a4b09179189138163a39436634b461
# What should happen
Sway should not crash. Interestingly, when I press $mod+backslash, it works (which will run `termite --name="scratchterm_full`)
Here's a log with just $mod+backslash pressed: https://gist.github.com/camoz/9cb9d7d0719c731e4e56df42452bf8f3

The difference is obviously the size of the window:
`for_window [app_id="scratchterm"] floating enable; border none; resize set 100 ppt 50 ppt; move absolute 0 23; move scratchpad; scratchpad show`
`for_window [app_id="scratchterm_full"] floating enable; border none; resize set 100 ppt 100 ppt; move absolute 0 23; move scratchpad; scratchpad show`
comments:
Maybe this is related to https://github.com/swaywm/sway/issues/3235

Should I also provide a stack trace here?

Here it crashed without the scratchpad involved (stack trace): https://gist.github.com/camoz/f3265830fb868ae7b80813d5888297b6

In config:
`bindsym $mod+Shift+backslash exec termite --name="scratchterm_full"`
`for_window [app_id="scratchterm_full"] floating enable; border none; resize set 100 ppt 100 ppt; move absolute 1280 23`

Then hitting $mod+Shift+backslash...

review_comments: This breaks a floating terminal which was resized using a `for_window [app_id="quick_scratchpad"] mark quick, move scratchpad, resize set 1600 900` directive. The resize command is no longer applied (but worked before).
